title: Cosmic Painters
description: Two women wearing wide-brimmed hats stand at easels in the foreground, painting a vibrant cosmic vortex. Behind them stretches a massive swirling black hole surrounded by colorful orbiting orbs and a surreal, undulating landscape under a dramatic painted sky.
prompt: Two women in sun hats and long dresses stand at wooden easels painting a giant swirling cosmic vortex and black hole in the sky. They are painting the exact same surreal scene that surrounds them, with colorful glowing orbs and nebulae orbiting the central eye of the vortex. Rolling hills blend into the cosmic swirls, dramatic painted sky with orange and teal clouds, whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere.
